notes.title: Thief Simulator 2 - Pre-release Notes
notes.content:
[h2]🚨🔥Just ONE DAY left! Are you ready to sneak, steal, and strategize? The ultimate heist is almost here! 🔥🚨[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/4603da53915a6bb2564dc40af1602574f2813dad.jpg[/img]

Attention all aspiring thieves! We're just around the corner from the grand launch of Thief Simulator 2. Here's everything you need to know:

📅 [b]Release Date:[/b] October 4, 2023

⏰ [b]Release Time:[/b]
[list][*] CEST: 15:00
[*] EDT (USA East Coast): 09:00
[*] PDT (USA West Coast): 06:00
[*] CST (China): 21:00
[*] IST (India): 18:30[/list]
💸 [b]Price:[/b] 19.99 EUR/USD

🎉 [b]Launch Discount: [/b]Get 10% off for the first 7 days after release!

[h2][b]Key Features[/b][/h2]

🏘️ [b]Maps[/b]: Dive into two large neighborhood maps featuring over 20 houses of varied sizes, each with a unique resident and unique behavior. Plus, tackle three medium-sized heist maps - a resort with 6 homes and a stealable golf cart, a warehouse with guards and a forklift, and a bank filled with gold.

📜[b] Missions:[/b] Engage in over 30 varied tasks. Whether it's planting a package, destroying evidence, or pulling off the perfect theft, there's always work for a skilled thief. Hunt for one-time contracts on unique items, car theft missions, car dismantling tasks, and over 30 Blackbay lists comprising diverse items that will fetch a pretty penny.

💪 [b]Special Skills:[/b] Enhance your thief's capabilities with special skills (check out those fancy pink or blue icons on the right!).

🏡 [b]Home Upgrades: [/b]A thief's home is their castle. Upgrade yours to facilitate your nefarious activities.

🚁 [b]Drones & Upgrades: [/b]Scout and plan better with different drones, each offering unique capabilities. Don't forget to upgrade them for even more sneaky power!

🤫 [b]Mystery on Madison St.:[/b] There's something very unusual in Madison St. and only 0.1% of players have the chance to encounter it. Will you be one of them?

[h2]🎥 New Trailer: Ready to get even more hyped? Check out our new trailer here.[/h2]

[previewyoutube=lSieK1HHt68;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Special Offers[/b][/h2]

🕹️[b] For the Veterans.[/b] Special discount for owners of:
[list][*] Thief Simulator 1
[*] American Theft 80s[/list]
🎮 [b]Friends & Family Discounts.[/b] For those who have other games from PlayWay, you're in for a treat. Eligible games:
[list][*] Car Mechanic Simulator 2021
[*] Prison Simulator
[*] Into the Flames
[*] Bum Simulator
[*] Farmers life
[*] Barnfinders
[*] Mr. Prepper
[*] Accident
[*] Police Shootout
[*] Gunsmith
[*] Contraband Police
[*] House Flipper[/list]

Get ready to embrace the world of thievery all over again! 🎩🔦🔐

Stay sneaky and see you in-game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332720/Thief_Simulator_2/

Regards,
Rafal, Ultimate Games Team

notes.title: Thief Simulator 2: Community Challenge and Thief Tools
notes.content:
Hey, stealth enthusiasts and master burglars in the making,

[h2]Community Challenge: Unlock the Ultimate Loot — A Hefty Launch Discount![/h2]

If you accept our mission, the huge Thief Simulator 2 community challenge will reward the cunningest and most devoted of thieves. Your job? Gather your fellow thieves, improve your heist techniques, and make sure everyone is playing Thief Simulator 2 on Steam. The launch discount you'll unlock increases as we gain more followers. Keep in mind that our strength lies in our numbers!

[b]The tiers are as follows:[/b]
[list][*] 13,250 followers - unlock a [b]5%[/b] launch discount
[*] 14,500 followers - unlock a [b]10%[/b] launch discount
[*] 17,000 followers - unlock a [b]15%[/b] launch discount
[*] 20,000 followers - unlock a massive [b]20%[/b] launch discount[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/cc6c3fae060ecb103cf1d4554a1ad86901e45ff0.jpg[/img]

We know that thieves [b]prefer freebies,[/b] but hey, a generous discount isn’t half bad, right? So, gather your burglar buddies, spread the word, and let’s hit that 20,000 followers mark — because even thieves love a good bargain!

So just do a simple click here! Follow & add to your Wishlist so you don't release the launch discount and game release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332720/Thief_Simulator_2/

[h2]Let’s Talk Tools of the Trade[/h2]
It's crucial to become familiar with the tools you need as you polish your abilities for the ideal robbery. These aren't just any tools; they are the tools that will make you the greatest thief in Thief Simulator 2. They are your keys to success, your henchmen, and your tools of the trade. Let's examine a few in more detail:

[b]Lockpick[/b]
This isn't your everyday lockpick; this tool allows you to tackle medium-difficulty locks and even cut open windows for that silent entry. It's the Swiss army knife for burglars! And there are a few versions of this tool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/bcd6ca0920271ecb0326aaedd17e708e064a4089.gif[/img]

[b]Neon Bot’ Drone[/b]
Scoping out your heist location has never been easier. Use the drone to mark tenants, inspect the area, and plan your path to victory. Remember, a well-prepared thief is a successful thief!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/8cee19240d1d07b97da6ab6eb9f067d809a4bece.gif[/img]

[b]Hacking Laptop[/b]
Some loot is behind high-tech security systems. But worry not, with your hacking laptop, disabling security panels and unlocking electronic doors will be a breeze. Make sure to map out the correct path and secure your prize.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/83d831f40b8cc1e46345e53c45e59f23147fbfbd.gif[/img]

[b]Sleeping Gas[/b]
Ensure a silent and undisturbed heist with the Sleeping Gas. It's your silent partner in crime, allowing you to swoop in and snatch valuables while everyone else is in a deep slumber. It's not just a tool; it's your ticket to a hassle-free burglary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/9328d792d2296eac35a9c9bcd1330c2aa020d407.gif[/img]

[h3]Here is the full arsenal at your disposal:[/h3]
[list][*] Flashlight
[*] Crowbar
[*] Basic Lockpicking Tool
[*] Lockpick
[*] Automatic lockpick
[*] Glass Cutter
[*] Micro Camera
[*] Binoculars
[*] Noisy walkie-talkie
[*] Dog meat
[*] Baton
[*] Stethoscope
[*] Car lock pick gun
[*] Car signal hijacker
[*] Blowtorch
[*] Sleeping Gas
[*] Respirator
[*] Tranquilizer gun
[*] Tranquilizer dart
[*] Car disassembly toolbox
[*] Shovel
[*] Neon Bot' drone
[*] Quiet shoes
[*] Ski mask
[*] Jewellery tools
[*] Night vision goggles
[*] Hacking laptop
[*] ATM Hacking Tool
[*] Hacking PDA[/list]
A word of advice, using the tranquilizer gun or sleeping gas won’t raise alarms as it ensures your victims won't call the police upon waking up, unlike when using a baton.

We've only begun to scrape the surface of the playground for thieves, so stay tuned. The following time, we'll delve even further into Thief Simulator 2's underworld and uncover even more tips and tricks to help you become a master of your trade. Keep in mind that knowledge is your biggest ally in the realm of theft!

Keep an eye out and get your tools ready until then. The next revelation is quickly approaching. Future master thieves, let the games begin!

See you in prison folks! ːcozyroeː
